summary_1line: During a chaotic battle between gods and Rakshasas, Ravana’s son Meghnada uses magic to defeat and capture Indra, forcing the gods into retreat.

image_candidates.scene_text: A battlefield river of blood filled with floating weapons and circling vultures flows among fallen Rakshasas and shattered chariots.
Indra on the white elephant Airavata charges into the sky while the invisible Meghnada binds him with magical power.
Ravana roars in fury from his speeding chariot as volleys of arrows from both sides darken the sky and blot out the sun.
